title: Gate state
description: The state of one human gate (HG1 or HG2) on a corpus row. Ruled 2026-09-06 by rulings-bench card D10-corpus-selection; recorded in SPEC.md §7.3.2. A waived HG1 is an ORDINARY outcome, not a degraded one, so 'waived' and 'not-sought' must be distinguishable from 'pending' in the artifact rather than inferred from a row that never advanced.

gate.description: Which gate. HG1 is the domain-expert review of the inert-style L4; HG2 is Meng's go on anything outward-facing.

review.description: pending = sought and not yet answered, and the only state that may ever block. granted = a reviewer signed off. waived = deliberately released without review; per SPEC.md §7.3.1 this is expected for HG1 and is not a defect. not-sought = the row never asked. withheld = a reviewer looked and declined.

by.description: Who granted, waived or withheld. Required in practice for granted/waived/withheld; not schema-enforced because historical rows predate the field.

at.description: When the state was last set.

note.description: Free text. For a waiver, why it was waived rather than sought.
